system.description: Armor Class: 5 (or as form) Hit Dice: 3 + 1 (M, or as form) Move: 120' (40') or as form Attacks: 1 weapon or as form Damage: By weapon type or form No. Appearing: 1d6(ld20) Save As: M11 Morale: 8 or 10 (see below) Treasure Type: Variable Intelligence: 14 Alignment: Any (often Chaotic) XP Value: 100 Monster Type: Humanoid (Common). Monster Type: Humanoid (Rare). Mermen are water-breathing humanoids. A merman has the upper body of a man and the lower body of a large fish.
